_about: Single source of truth for Rev C enclosure and PCB mechanical geometry. Units: millimetres. Enclosure coordinates: origin at the front-left-bottom outer corner of the base, +X to the right, +Y toward the back, +Z up. Any key listed in _verify is a fit allowance or third-party dimension that has NOT been measured on real parts. source/build_cad.py reads this file; do not hard-code numbers there.
_button_note: The B3F body (about 3.5 mm tall) is taller than the 3.0 mm gap between PCB top and the top underside. The printed hood gets a 1 mm underside pocket; the acrylic top gets a 9 mm hole that clears the 6x6 body. Found by tests/check_cad.py.
tube_ring_gap_note: Tube-Tester lists the IN-14 bulb as 19 mm, so the radial gap to the 19.4 mm opening is only 0.2 mm nominal; real bulbs vary, which is why coupon 06 is printed first. Baffle collars in the printed hood block line-of-sight to leads; the clear-top option has no collars. See docs/VALIDATION.md open items.

all_printed._uses: 4x M2x8 bottom, 5x M2x6 PCB, 2x M2x6 cable clamp

clear_top._uses: 4x M2x8 bottom, 5x M2x4 PCB, 4x M2x6 top, 2x M2x6 cable clamp
